topic: Day 31 — carousel — Who you become is decided on your worst days, not your best

slides.text: Your [worst] days decide who you become.
Anyone can be their best self when things go well.
Good days require good circumstances, not character.
Worst days are the only real test.

caption:
Anyone can be their best self when things are going well. The accumulated pattern of hard days is what actually defines a person over time.

Follow for one of these a day.
